description: CS0401 assessments: ten questions per unit, with individual attempt and answer history. Questions 1–5 are tracing; 6–10 are code writing. The supplied archive contains no surveys.

pages.title:
**Programming Questionnaire **   

We are interested in your background, thoughts, feelings, and experience with computer programming and how you study/learn computer programming and in general. 

Please answer these questions **as honestly as you can. **There are **no right or wrong answers**—we only want to know what you think and feel about programming and other aspects of life that could be related to studying at a college-level with the support of technology.   

Answers will **have no impact on grading** and will **only be used for research purposes** and the responses will be **ANONYMIZED**. 

Please, read the attached** consent form** and** please provide your consent** by selecting one of the options below. Your participation in the study is completely voluntary.

pages.title:
Now we are interested in your opinions about automated technology –i.e.,technology that can perform certain functions automatically without any input from you. Automated technology is taking on more and more tasks in various areas of life. For example, robots are becoming more widely used in industry and in private households and many programs and systems we use daily are currently based on artificial intelligence (e.g. language assistants, image recognition).

Here there's a number of statements about automated technology in general that may apply to you more or less. Please respond to each of these statements by indicating the extent to which you agree or disagree with the statement, i.e. how much it applies to you.

rows.prompt: Even though I may sometimes suffer the consequences of trusting automated technological systems, I still prefer to trust than not to trust them
I rarely trust automated technological systems because I can’t handle the uncertainty.
Automated technological systems are competent.
I am wary about the capabilities of automated technological systems.
I don’t expect that automated technological systems are willing to assist and support people.
I feel that automated technological systems can be relied upon to do what they say they will do.

survey.end_text:
We thank you for your time spent taking this survey.
Your response has been recorded.
